columns.expression: (case "role" when 'owner' then 0 when 'admin' then 1 when 'manager' then 2 when 'editor' then 3 when 'viewer' then 4 else 5 end)

user_tokens_live_email_idx.name: user_tokens_live_email_idx
user_tokens_live_email_idx.where: "user_tokens"."email" is not null and "user_tokens"."revoked_at" is null

user_tokens_revoked_unconsumed_idx.name: user_tokens_revoked_unconsumed_idx
user_tokens_revoked_unconsumed_idx.where: "user_tokens"."revoked_at" is not null and "user_tokens"."consumed_at" is null

user_tokens_shape_check.name: user_tokens_shape_check
user_tokens_shape_check.value: ("user_tokens"."purpose" = 'refresh' and "user_tokens"."user_id" is not null and "user_tokens"."email" is null and "user_tokens"."app" is null and "user_tokens"."redirect" is null and "user_tokens"."invitation_id" is null) or ("user_tokens"."purpose" = 'sign_in_link' and "user_tokens"."user_id" is null and "user_tokens"."session_id" is null and "user_tokens"."email" is not null and "user_tokens"."app" is not null and "user_tokens"."invitation_id" is null) or ("user_tokens"."purpose" = 'step_up_link' and "user_tokens"."user_id" is not null and "user_tokens"."session_id" is not null and "user_tokens"."email" is not null and "user_tokens"."app" is not null and "user_tokens"."redirect" is null and "user_tokens"."invitation_id" is null) or ("user_tokens"."purpose" = 'invitation_link' and "user_tokens"."user_id" is null and "user_tokens"."session_id" is null and "user_tokens"."email" is not null and "user_tokens"."app" is not null and "user_tokens"."redirect" is null and "user_tokens"."invitation_id" is not null)
